title: Board layout pass
notes: Six board changes, each with its own switch in Settings > Playmat & frame > Board layout.
Zone depth: the three battlefield zones look like shelves with a soft inner shadow.

Stack identical lands and tokens: identical cards pile into one with a count badge; click the badge to spread them out, and click it again to pile them up. Cards with counters, attachments or different states stay separate.
Dim cards that cannot act: tapped lands and summoning-sick creatures are a little duller.
Mana and phase strip: a slim strip on the board edge shows the current step, what comes next, floating mana, your land drop and the stack size.
Combat lane: once attackers are declared, they move to a lit lane at the front of the creature zone.
Fanned graveyard: the top three graveyard cards show fanned out.
